interpretation_rules.interpretation: Microbiome-only reciprocal validation is the principal directly transportable molecular analysis.
Metabolome-only transfer is an as-supplied-scale stress test.
interpretation_rules.qualification: Paired cohorts lack verified common metabolomics measurement semantics and units.

interpretation_rules.interpretation: Early integration is also an as-supplied-scale stress test.
Decision-score ROC-AUC measures ranking under domain shift.
interpretation_rules.qualification: It is not evidence of deployable calibrated probability transport.

interpretation_rules.interpretation: Saturated/compressed probabilities and one-class predictions prevent clinical classification or calibration claims.
interpretation_rules.qualification: Thresholded outputs are diagnostic only when transfer probabilities fail.

interpretation_rules.interpretation: High AUC must not be described as operational transportability where thresholds or probabilities fail.
interpretation_rules.qualification: AUC and deployable clinical classification answer different questions.

interpretation_rules.interpretation: No claim should be made that CRC biology is intrinsically less reproducible.
interpretation_rules.qualification: Observed performance reflects these cohorts, platforms, feature spaces and stress-test assumptions.

interpretation_rules.interpretation: Paired comparisons remain conditional on the stress-test representation.
interpretation_rules.qualification: They should not be used as proof of common-scale metabolomics transport.
